title: FedNow Participation Readiness Scorer
description: Scores institution readiness against all 47 FedNow technical and operational participation requirements across 6 domains: Core Banking Connectivity, ISO 20022 Message Formats, Fraud Monitoring, Liquidity Management, Dispute & Return Handling, and Operational SLA & Governance. Outputs a prioritised gap checklist, implementation roadmap, and AP2 JSON participation mandate. Client-side. Zero PII.

institution_type.description: Type of financial institution seeking FedNow participation

core_banking_system.description: Core banking platform — used to contextualise integration complexity

item_statuses.description: Map of requirement IDs to completion status. Keys: cbc1–cbc8, iso1–iso8, fraud1–fraud8, liq1–liq8, dispute1–dispute7, sla1–sla8. Values: 'yes' | 'partial' | 'no'.

overall_readiness_pct.description: Weighted readiness score as a percentage of 47 requirements

domain_scores.description: Per-domain readiness percentage scores keyed by domain ID

top_open_gap_ids.description: IDs of up to 8 most critical open gaps

agent_instructions.description: Ordered remediation actions for an agent or programme manager

ap2_mandate.description: Full AP2 JSON mandate object — ap2_version 1.0, mandate_type payment_policy

mcp_tool_definition.name: score_fednow_participation_readiness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Scores a financial institution's readiness against all 47 FedNow participation requirements across 6 domains and outputs a gap checklist, implementation roadmap, and AP2 JSON mandate. Use when an agent needs to assess FedNow readiness, identify participation gaps, generate a remediation roadmap, or produce a FedNow policy mandate for a US bank, credit union, or non-bank payment institution. Distinct from Tool 06 (FedNow participant directory lookup) — this tool assesses internal operational readiness, not counterparty participation status.

item_statuses.description: 47 requirement statuses — keys: cbc1–cbc8, iso1–iso8, fraud1–fraud8, liq1–liq8, dispute1–dispute7, sla1–sla8. Values: 'yes' | 'partial' | 'no'.
